newsitem.title: USA: Coach USA sees more acquisitions in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Coach USA sees more acquisitions in 1996.

text.p: Coach USA, which earlier announced the purchase of six privately-held ground transportation companies, plans to pursue its acquisition strategy and complete more transactions this year.

In a brief telephone interview, chief financial officer Larry King also said the company will disclose the financial impact of the latest acquisitions on Wednesday. He described the latest acquisitions as "very accretive."
Coach USA, which went public in May at 14 per share, was unchanged in late morning trading at 23-3/4 after paring early losses.
King said Coach USA is currently negotiating with other companies for potential acquisitions.
